2608.23296.title: Sigmoid Attention as a Better Substrate for Learned KV Cache Eviction
2608.23296.paper_summary: Learned KV-cache eviction often faces a soft-to-hard mismatch: during training, differentiable gates typically attenuate token contributions, whereas inference saves memory only when KV entries are physically removed. We ask whether the attention substrate affects this soft-to-hard transition. Using GPT-2-scale Transformers trained on OpenWebText, we run a controlled $2\times2\times2$ comparison over attention type, learned gating, and positional encoding. Although sigmoid attention is worse as a dense language model, learned hard eviction changes the useful operating points: sigmoid-gated models delete KV entries with negligible PPL change relative to their own no-eviction references. Under a matched live-cache protocol on the same dense backbones, learned sigmoid gates obtain lower PPL than our H$_2$O and KeyDiff implementations, whereas softmax gates do not uniformly beat these post-hoc methods. The results suggest that attention normalization can substantially affect whether a training-time soft gate transfers cleanly to hard KV deletion.
2608.23296.paper_summary_zh: 學習的 KV 緩存驅逐通常面臨軟硬不匹配的問題：在訓練過程中，可微分的閘門通常會減弱標記的貢獻，而在推理時只有在 KV 項目被物理移除時才會節省內存。我們詢問注意力基底是否影響這一軟硬過渡。使用在 OpenWebText 上訓練的 GPT-2 規模的Transformer，我們對注意力類型、學習閘門和位置編碼進行了受控的 $2\times2\times2$ 比較。儘管 sigmoid 注意力作為一種密集語言模型表現較差，但學習的硬驅逐改變了有用的操作點：sigmoid 閘控模型刪除 KV 項目時，相對於其自身的無驅逐參考，PPL 變化可忽略不計。在相同的密集骨幹上進行匹配的實時緩存協議下，學習的 sigmoid 閘門獲得的 PPL 低於我們的 H$_2$O 和 KeyDiff 實現，而 softmax 閘門則未必在這些事後方法中均表現優於。結果表明，注意力正規化可以顯著影響訓練時的軟閘門是否能順利轉移到硬 KV 刪除。
